In Easy difficulty, you only got cash from them if they were killed in this map, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gotten was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. In solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy was killed or damaged enough. With each additional player, this decreaseds by 25%, which meant that in a quad, you only got 25% of the cash. This amount was distributed between players based on how much damage they dealt. However, if a player did not deal any damage, they would receive a percentage of the enemy's full cash upon its death or when it was damaged enough, which was 12.5% in duo, 16.7% in trio and 18.75% in quad. In Mega and Impossible difficulties, you only got cash if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. It used a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player did all the damage to an enemy, both players would receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this was reduced to 50% in duo and 33% in trio. took place inside a corrupted temple controlled by the Korblox. It was mostly blue and black. Multiple ghostly trees and stalagmite were scattered around the temple. Multiple small cliffs could also be found on the map. On one side of the map there was a giant entrance to the temple, which was locked. Lightning struck around the entire map.
There was a green path, which slowly got corrupted as the waves go on. It started at a glowing gate and ended at another gate, which lead to the exit from the temple.

Loadouts could be selected in both Easy and Mega difficulties. Alongside these preset options, players on Easy difficulty could opt to use the player's current loadout as the first choice. However, if one's loadout contained no towers, this option would be unavailable. Mega used to have its own set of loadouts, though they were replaced with Easy difficulty loadouts on the 24th of March 2025.
